subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: Should finalized provider-reported per-call costs become part of the canonical agent-facing usage/session contract, and if so how should they take precedence over the existing estimated `cost.turn_usd` value?
rationale: The repository currently separates provider billing from session estimates, and OpenRouter’s authoritative value may be finalized asynchronously; selecting the public schema, source semantics, and rendering precedence is a product/API decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Add a typed exact-cost contract
options.body: Expose provider-reported and estimated values in one provider-neutral typed structure, with explicit source, units, and finality, and prefer finalized provider cost when available.

options.title: Expose a dedicated cost query
options.body: Keep reply and session fields estimate-based, but add an agent-callable tool or RPC for finalized per-call and cumulative provider charges.

options.title: Keep exact cost operator-only
options.body: Retain provider-reported billing in transcripts and operator usage views without making it available to agents or automatic reply rendering.

recommendation.title: Add a typed exact-cost contract
recommendation.body: Expose provider-reported and estimated values in one provider-neutral typed structure, with explicit source, units, and finality, and prefer finalized provider cost when available.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history across the affected transport, session usage, runtime metadata, documentation, and prior product review.
